nodes.label: 2026-08-12-entity-nodes-and-tag-cleanup-design.md — DRAFT design for the user's sign-off: entity nodes (ids only) and the PR-title/URL tag cleanup on a versioned copy of herb-eval. Nothing in it is decided by its existence; every section separates DECIDED (his words, cited) from OPEN (his ruling needed) and every number is tagged with its source: [DB] read-only Cypher on herb-eval 2026-08-12, [CORPUS] read-only parse of v3/data/corpus/Salesforce__HERB, [MAP] chunk locator_json resolved against the corpus records for all 4,869 chunks (0 unparseable locators, 0 out-of-bounds indices, 0 slack channel-name mismatches). No code, no graph write, no model call; herb was never touched and gold-blindness held.

Authority and layering. The closed spine is his 2026-06-12 ruling — Source → File → Chunk → Tag as the only nodes, hard fields as chunk attributes, "no entity/record nodes, no minted edges" (v3/artefact/keys/Salesforce__HERB.yaml:1-4, carried in CLAUDE.md §Artefact arm). The lineage is layered, not linear (CONTRADICTION_MAP T5): 06-12 attributes and closed spine (second-hand); 06-30/07-01 his own turn "i really think this should be nodes or edges … half the strength of of a graph is beeing able to route/search based on relationships" (turns:L446) aimed at the concept, "Dont think herb, think dataset agnostic concept" (turns:L454); 08-02 a hub-node restructuring onto herb-eval rejected — "dude, you are turbo-overfitting now, AND doing shit that might as well be sql-schema" (turns:L4249). The draft exists on his 2026-08-12 order: "wouldnt it be way more reasonable to make those fields into nodes to get actual use of this beeing in a graph?", "yeah, what raw data would actually enter the graph tho? can we still claim to be \"secure\" if so?", "ok, so, lets do this then, draft a new design based on these thoughts and herb-eval, including removing the pr-titles and url's". Neither the draft nor the statements make the new shape canon: the sign-off does.

What the graph is today [MEASURED, DB 2026-08-12]: Source 1 · File 33 (30 product files + 3 metadata files) · Chunk 4,869 · Tag 19,716 · CONTAINS 33 · HAS_CHUNK 4,869 · HAS_TAG 67,913. Four empty leftovers in the schema: labels CanonicalTag, CanonicalTagProposal, Run and relationship type TAGGED, all at count 0. Chunk properties by coverage: chunk_id, chunk_ref, created_at, desc_emb, end_offset, file_id, kind, locator_json, ordinal, parent_ref, relevance_to_file, start_offset, token_estimate on all 4,869; product 4,808; section 4,808; msg_index_start/end 3,706; years 3,476; channel 2,669; item_index 1,163; doc_field 569; part_index 569; metadata_section 61; employee_id 30; subsection 14. created_at has 7 distinct values — build timestamps, not source dates. Tags carry name and emb only. Sections: slack 2,669 · prs 935 · documents 786 · meeting_transcripts 347 · urls 61 · meeting_chats 10; 30 products; 294 channels.

Two facts the design has to face. The graph already contains mirrored directories: the 61 chunks without product/section are metadata chunks — 30 of kind org_tree (one per salesforce_team.json item, each carrying an employee_id property; these ARE the 30 employee_id chunks, 18 distinct eids), 27 directory_batch chunks over employee.json, 4 over customers_data.json, carrying 1,010 HAS_TAG edges. The v1 build mirrored the directories and the org tree into the graph, which the directory rule forbids (Salesforce__HERB.yaml:63-64: org hierarchy "read on demand, never mirrored into the graph"). Standing fact, flagged; what happens to these 61 chunks is his call (OPEN-4). And today's person linkage is those 30 org-tree chunks and nothing else: employee_id coverage is 30/4,869 = 0.6% of chunks, all metadata mirrors, zero content chunks.

A — Entity nodes (ids only). The security constraint is the boundary condition: what enters the graph is identifier strings, role labels and provenance pointers — no names, no prose, ever; names resolve through the raw directories at answer time. Person carries one property, the id string in its source id-space: eid_… 512 observed in corpus structured fields of the directory's 530, with 18 directory entries that never appear getting no node, so the directory is not mirrored (full-corpus resolution against employee.json: slack speakers 512/521 = 98.3%, document authors 107/107, meeting participants 429/429, superseding the YAML's 2026-05-30 spot rates); EMP_… PR logins, directory-less, 2,561 distinct PR-author + 2,575 distinct reviewer logins, union 4,590; CUST-… appearing literally in content text, 1,043 chunk-customer pairs covering all 120 customers by exact regex, zero in structured fields. Malformed leftovers measured and handled explicitly: 4 quote-wrapped ids, 4 short-hex ids, slack_admin_bot — flagged loudly, never invented. Product 30 nodes from the 30 product files. Channel 294 nodes from the distinct channel values, with the honesty note that 224 of 294 channel identifiers embed an employee name.

Measured pathology of the EMP_ population: at chunk grain every one of the 4,590 has degree exactly 1 (median 1, max 1) [MAP] — they would be 90% of Person nodes and carry zero linking value, the same shape as the degree-1 slug tags. Whether they become nodes at all is OPEN-2. 266 PR-author and 279 reviewer logins are eid-shaped and resolve through the employee directory, so those merge with the employee population regardless. Person-node degree over structured roles: the eid population is all 512 at ≥2 chunks, median 47, max 160.

Years and section — attributes or nodes, the data argues and the call is his (OPEN-1). Measured: years covers 3,476 chunks with 3,680 chunk-year memberships over 36 distinct year values, 1812–2059 — a 5-value head (2026: 2,484 · 2027: 437 · 2024: 349 · 2025: 329 · 2023: 22) and a 31-value noise tail at 1–17 chunks each. As nodes the head years are hubs touching up to 51% of chunks (2026), near-zero discrimination, the salesforce mega-tag shape (534 chunks, 11%); the tail is noise from the baked v1 extraction. section has 6 values and is file-structural. Both already support exact filtering as attributes; what nodes would add is only year/section-scoped traversal, and measured fuel for that is thin.

B — Edges [PROPOSAL, every count measured, MAP throughout]. One edge type INVOLVES (name open), chunk→Person with a role property derived from field structure, plus chunk→Product and chunk→Channel, deduplicated at (chunk, person, role); all derivations are deterministic field reads, no model in the loop. role=speaker from /slack/*/Message/User/userId — 13,690 edges, 521 entities, 2,669 chunks (100% of slack chunks); role=participant from /meeting_transcripts/*/participants/* — 9,964, 429, 347 (100%); role=reviewer from /prs/*/reviews/*/user/login — 4,349, 2,575, 935 (100%); role=pr_author from /prs/*/user/login — 3,492, 2,561, 935; role=doc_author from /documents/*/author — 786, 107, 786 (100%). Structured total 32,281 edges over 5,111 persons covering 4,737 = 97.3% of chunks, against 30 today. chunk→Product 4,808 over 30; chunk→Channel 2,669 over 294. meeting_chats records carry no person field at all ({text, id} only) so their 10 chunks stay person-edge-free, and the 61 urls chunks likewise from structure.

The mentioned role — three distinct mechanisms, separately decidable (OPEN-3) [MAP]: eid_… id appears in content text, 8,591 edges over 514 entities, deterministic regex; CUST-… id in content text, 1,043 over 120, deterministic regex; EMP_… id in content text, 0 over 0, measured absent; employee full name in text → id via directory, 9,685 over 97, needs a name resolver (build-time lookup, only the id stored); customer full name in text → id, 750 over 8, same. The name rows are case-sensitive exact full-name matches and are lower bounds. The two regex mechanisms are the same class of deterministic derivation as the structured roles; the name-resolver rows are a different animal, bounded here and not proposed.

Product cross-references: measured zero. Own-product name in a chunk's text — 1,619 chunk-product pairs. A different product's name — 0 in the entire mapped corpus [MAP]. Product edges are purely file-structural; any cross-product bridging must come through shared persons or channels, not product co-mention. Stated so nobody designs against fuel that does not exist.

Explicitly excluded from the design: org-tree / manager edges, which would mirror salesforce_team.json structure into the graph against the directory rule (Salesforce__HERB.yaml:63-64; nearest user words the 08-02 rejection, turns:L4249) — an org layer is its own decision (OPEN-4), which also owns the fate of the 61 existing mirror chunks; names on any node, ids only, names live in raw and resolve at answer time; any prose — no titles, no summaries, no descriptions on entity nodes; model-emitted anything — all edges are field reads, so the tagger/interpreter no-numbers rule is untouched.

What retrieval could do with them [PROPOSAL — shapes, not promises]. No performance claims: the motivation is the measured wall — pool-ceiling recall is 1.0 on both legs, all loss is ordering, and every re-rank of the existing door values walls at ~0.79–0.80 on 10smoke — and the prescribed way out is a new signal family, not a re-mix. Shapes: 1 a person-scoped part, MATCH (p:Person {id:$id})<-[:INVOLVES]-(c:Chunk), entering as its own part beside the stated-scope part, proposing and weighting under the no-gates rule, never excluding; 2 a shared-entity two-hop (c1)-[:INVOLVES]->(p:Person)<-[:INVOLVES]-(c2), measured fuel 512 eid persons at median 47 chunks each; 3 role-typed variants of 1–2; 4 degree as a discriminativeness signal, person degree spanning 1–160; 5 a channel-scoped part. Any of these reaching the arm's value system is a later experiment with its own pre-stated hypothesis, control and decision rule; none is part of this sign-off (OPEN-8), and the graveyard of value-knee cuts, chord walks, spacing stop rules and re-ranks stands measured and rejected.

C — Tag cleanup, his order 'removing the pr-titles and url's'. The removal predicate as code-shape: slug(s) = lowercase, every non-alphanumeric run → _, strip _; S_titles = tag_names ∩ slug(prs[].title) 1,636 tags / 2,381 edges; S_links = ∩ slug(prs[].link) 1,173 / 1,220 ∪ ∩ slug(urls[].link) 26 / 26 ∪ ∩ slug(documents[].document_link) 1 / 1; R_url = {startswith https_ or www_} 1,203 / 1,250 ∪ {startswith github_com_} 643 / 716; R_pr = {fullmatch github_pr_\d+} 453 / 911 ∪ {fullmatch .+_pr_\d+} 528 / 988 ∪ {fullmatch pull_request_\d+} 52 / 86 ∪ {contains _pull_\d+} 1,790 / 1,857; REMOVE = union. The union: 4,111 tags, 5,470 edges = 8.05% of 67,913, mean degree 1.33, 2,240 chunks touched, 0 chunks losing ALL tags; post-cleanup vocabulary 15,605 tags / 62,443 edges. Bare http_ is deliberately NOT in R_url — its 14 tags / 33 edges are protocol concepts (http_2_connections, http_3_handshake, http_client, http_headers, http_https); the naive prefix rule gives 4,125 / 5,503 / 8.10% and kills those 14 concepts.

Reconciliation with the record and the predicate's honest cost. The slug class S = 2,836 tags is exactly the 08-02 corpus-facts figure, now decomposed: 1,636 title slugs + 1,173 pr-link slugs + 26 urls-link slugs + 1 document_link slug. The 08-11 inventory's pattern classes (PR-pointer any form 2,505; URL-shaped 1,842; union 2,556 / 3,232 edges = 4.76% at mean degree 1.29) sit inside REMOVE up to boundary drawing — the regex union of the same intent is 2,489 / 3,122, the ~67-tag delta being digitless forms (airflow_pr) and class-edge choices. The full REMOVE is larger than either circulating figure because his order adds the title slugs: 8.05% of edges, not 4.76%. Concept collisions: 102 of the 1,636 title-slug tags have degree ≥3 — the same string is a PR title on one chunk and a working concept on others (session_fixation_vulnerability 15 chunks, inefficient_query_execution_plan 11, cache_invalidation_bug 11, data_at_rest_encryption 10). Vocabulary-level removal kills the tag everywhere; edge-level removal preserves concept duty but needs per-edge provenance recomputed from locators. Which level is OPEN-5.

Measured impact bounds, with their conditions. Retrieval effect of the whole tag path under the current det weighting: HERB_W_TAG=0 scored 0.7401 recall_id against the 0.7339 default — delta +0.0062, 95% CI [−0.0040, +0.0165], 4/2/94 W/L/T, det leg, gold-100, k=50 — so the entire tag path switched off moves nothing distinguishable from zero under that leg and weighting, which is the ceiling on what this cleanup can change in that configuration. The 07-22 door trace measured the det tag door touching ~1 chunk/question on 10smoke; the circulating finer figure 'the tag path feeds ~0.78% of pool membership' was not found on disk and is carried as UNVERIFIED. The geometry effect is the real change: the tightest cluster in the whole tag embedding space is the n=488 github_pr_NNNN bin at 0.94 intra-cosine, consecutive PR ids at 0.9925, and the 488 sit inside R_pr and disappear — every tag-distance mechanism loses the strongest seam in its space, a consequence to expect and re-measure, not a promised benefit. The 3.110 GB tag-distance cache is keyed to the vocabulary and is invalidated by any removal. The 61 metadata chunks' 1,010 HAS_TAG edges are untouched by the predicate.

Mechanics — OPEN options with costs (OPEN-6). Either way herb-eval as benchmarked stays untouched and queryable, so every standing run's provenance survives. Option 1, versioned copy with in-place deletion: restore the git-lfs dump (v3/artefact/data/herb-eval.dump) into a new database name and run the predicate as MATCH (t:Tag) WHERE <predicate> DETACH DELETE t on the copy — cheap, fully reversible by re-restore, exact predicate recorded. Option 2, full sibling rebuild from raw: expensive, and it does not exist as a runnable path since the v1 tagger run is baked and a rebuild re-opens tagging itself. One version or two: if cleanup and entity nodes land in a single new DB, no future measurement can attribute a delta to one alone; two versions keep the mechanisms separable at the cost of a second restore and run set. Graph identity is the provenance gap the design must close (OPEN-7): no manifest today records which graph or tag run a result came from, so the new graph gets an identity — database name, version string, removal predicate hash, parent dump identity — and every future RunManifest records it.

D — The security claim, exact wording and no more: "No source content is stored in the graph. Nodes and edges carry only identifier strings from the source's own id-spaces (pseudonymous person ids, product names, channel identifiers, year integers), structural attributes, and locators (references) into a held-back raw store. Every human-readable text is resolved from the raw store at answer time. Person identifiers are pseudonymous; their resolution to names exists only through directories that never enter the graph." What makes the first sentence true again is the cleanup: today the tag layer carries 2,836 verbatim field-value slugs. Residuals stated so 'secure' is never claimed unqualified: interaction structure is exposed (who spoke in which channel, who reviewed whose PR, who met whom — pseudonymous ids with rich structure are re-identifiable in principle); this corpus's identifiers embed names (224 of 294 channel identifiers, 298 surviving tags over 322 edges); surviving tags are still model-written contextual phrases about content; and T3's oracle residue transfers to any copy, unfixed and unworsened.

E — Relation to the benchmark and the paper. Nothing changes for any arm until a new graph version exists and is re-run: lucene and vector never touch the graph, and both artefact legs query herb-eval and keep doing so until a version switch is ordered — no existing number moves. Every existing number keeps its provenance; numbers from a new graph version are new numbers, never mixed, never compared as if same-graph, and the graph version becomes part of every figure's conditions. What a new version forces: at minimum the cheap continuity run — det leg, retrieval-only, gold-100, judge-free — on each new version; whether judged runs re-fire is his call, cost math first. Both legs stay reported; neither is 'the' artefact number ("Report both, decide nothing", 08-05). The abstract's phrase "relationships among documents, entities, communication threads, and events" is his pasted assumed construct, ruled "not canon, just an assumption": documents = File/Chunk spine, entities = Person and Product, communication threads = Channel nodes plus slack episode chunks, events = not represented, and the gap is stated rather than papered over.

F — Literature, kept separate from the draft's construction. Entity nodes beside text-unit nodes are established GraphRAG practice; the contrast is how the entities are obtained. GraphRAG (Edge et al. 2024, arXiv:2404.16130) builds an entity knowledge graph by LLM extraction and adds community summaries — this design does neither, entities come from structured id fields deterministically and summaries are prose the no-content rule forbids. HippoRAG (Gutiérrez et al., NeurIPS 2024, arXiv:2405.14831) runs Personalized PageRank over an entity–passage graph, precedent that entity–chunk link structure carries retrieval signal (their entities are open-vocabulary NER; these are closed id-spaces). NodeRAG (arXiv:2504.11544) argues heterogeneous node types over homogeneous graphs. Entity-oriented and expertise search (Balog, Entity-Oriented Search, Springer 2018; TREC Enterprise expert-finding) is the standard model for person-scoped enterprise questions. Property-graph RAG practice treats metadata filters and graph traversal as complementary — the exact trade OPEN-1 puts before him. No technique substitutes for his concepts: areas, levels of k's, parts, walk and stated-scope remain his, untranslated.

Decided and the execution defaults. His build order, 08-12, after the overfitting exchange: "well then, if you feel this is the way, construct another db using this, aka use the current as template and \"fix it\" and add these things, right?" — said after the uniform-not-curated generality argument (inclusion rules uniform over id-spaces, never curated by benchmark utility), which his "if you feel this is the way" delegates. Execution defaults under that order, each flagged in the build manifest and each still open as a ruling: OPEN-6 versioned copy, one combined new version; OPEN-1 Person + Product + Channel as proposed, years and section stay attributes; OPEN-2 all id-spaces in uniformly, EMP_ included and flagged low-value; OPEN-3 deterministic regex id-in-text mention edges in as their own relationship type, name-resolver edges out; OPEN-4 the 61 existing mirror chunks kept; OPEN-5 vocabulary-level predicate as specified (4,111 tags / 5,470 edges), bare http_ excluded, decision/date tags untouched; OPEN-7 new DB herb-eval-v2, build manifest carrying source DB, predicate + hash, counts and verification.

Open — enumerated for his ruling. 1 Node set: Person + Product + Channel as proposed, and years/section as attributes or nodes given the measured cardinalities. 2 The EMP_ population: 4,590 directory-less, all degree-1 — full Person nodes, edges only for the 266+279 eid-resolvable logins, or all in flagged low-value. 3 Mention edges: regex id-in-text (eid 8,591; CUST 1,043) in or out, name-resolver edges (9,685/97 employees, 750/8 customers) in or out. 4 Org tree and the 61 existing metadata-mirror chunks with their 1,010 tag edges: keep or drop in the new version. 5 Cleanup predicate final form: vocabulary-level vs edge-level for the 102 concept-collision titles, bare http_ in or out, whether decision-sentence and date tags join. 6 Mechanics: versioned-copy deletion vs rebuild, one combined version vs two. 7 Identity: new DB name, version string + predicate hash in every future RunManifest. 8 Access: whether and when the walk/scoring designs get the entity edges. 9 Re-run set beyond the det retrieval-only continuity run.

Assumptions ledger and the standing conflicts it touches. UNVERIFIED — 'the tag path feeds ~0.78% of pool membership', supplied in the drafting brief and not found in DATA_README or any state doc; used nowhere as load-bearing, the verified W_TAG=0 bound standing in its place. UNVERIFIED (pending) — the three 08-12 quotes are from the session and enter docs/canon/raw/user_turns_all.* at the next canon_extract union. VERIFIED-BY-CONSTRUCTION — locator mapping: 0 unparseable, 0 out-of-bounds, 0 slack channel-name mismatches across all 4,869 chunks. SUPPORTED — slug() reproduces the tagger's slugging, matching the independent 08-02 figures exactly. ASSUMED — name-mention bounds are lower bounds; the corpus view is the oracle-stripped one. Standing conflicts flagged, not resolved: T5 (this draft is its reopening, on his order), T15 (§3 is the first concrete removal proposal), T3 (oracle residue inherited by any copy), T4 (OPEN-7 is the fix path for graph identity), T11 (touched by §2.4(4)), T16 (14.1% content coverage unchanged).
